sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong Q3 results (32% GMV and revenue growth, 18% FCF margin) that beat management's own expectations, with North America outperforming. However, Q4 guidance projects a deceleration to mid-to-high-twenties revenue growth, explicitly citing tougher comparables and lapping the PayPal partnership, which tempers the forward signal. The score reflects genuine operational momentum and a slight FCF margin improvement, but not a formal guidance raise, placing it in the +0.15 to +0.3 band.

summary.revenue: $2,844 million for Q3 2025, up 32% year-over-year (31% constant currency).
summary.guidance: Q4 2025 revenue growth expected in the mid-to-high-twenties percentage rate year-over-year; gross profit dollars to grow at a low-to-mid-twenties rate; operating expense as a percentage of revenue to be 30% to 31%; stock-based compensation to be $130 million; free cash flow margin to be slightly above Q3 2025.
summary.margin: Gross profit margin was 48.9% in Q3 2025, down from 51.7% in Q3 2024. Operating income was $343 million, or 12% of revenue. Free cash flow margin was 18%.
key_risks: Q4 revenue growth will face tougher comparables from Q4 2024, the highest-growth quarter of that year.
Q4 revenue growth will be impacted by lapping the expanded PayPal partnership.
Transaction and loan losses represented 5% of revenue, an uptick above the historical trend line, driven by higher losses in the Payments business and increased capital losses.
MRR growth faces year-over-year comparability headwinds until Q2 of next year due to the rollout of 3-month trials.
Gross margin declined year-over-year due to mix shift toward Merchant Solutions and higher hosting and AI costs.
key_opportunities: International GMV grew 41% in Q3, with Europe a standout, and revenue from the region now accounts for 21% of overall revenue.
B2B GMV grew 98% year-over-year, with strong growth in Canada (155%) and the home and garden vertical (150%).
Shopify Payments penetration reached 65% of GMV, with Shop Pay processing $29 billion, up 67%.
AI-driven traffic to Shopify stores is up 7x and orders attributed to AI searches up 11x since January.
Sidekick adoption: over 750,000 shops used it for the first time in Q3, with nearly 100 million cumulative conversations.
Enterprise merchant wins, including Estée Lauder, e.l.f. Cosmetics, and FanDuel, support the enterprise migration trend.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly emphasizes consistent execution and growth, with Harley Finkelstein stating, 'We build. We ship. We grow. That's the model - and it's running at full speed.'
